Chapter 852: Chapter 2 The Tremor of Human Civilization (Subscribe Please)_2

This includes both the good intentions of the Black Star Lord and reveals a certain self-satisfaction.

But what the Black Star Lord never expected was that the Galaxy Master had actually stepped into Level Eleven before him?

“Galaxy Master? Level Eleven? So fast?”

“Surely, he is the strongest genius in the history of human civilization…”

“It’s been only about three hundred years since the Galaxy Master stepped into Tenth Rank, how did he cultivate?”

Many Tenth Rank Evolvers of Class A immediately began to discuss animatedly.

With the talent and aptitude that the Galaxy Master had shown, these many Class A Tenth Rankers had no doubt about his advancing into Level Eleven.

If the strongest genius in the history of human civilization couldn’t step into Level Eleven, then other Evolvers might as well not bother.

But wasn’t this speed too fast?

In less than three hundred years, not only did he deduce a Pillar-level Fusion Rule, but he also elevated it to the Second Realm?

All Class A Tenth Rankers were immensely shocked. What they didn’t know was that the Galaxy Master didn’t step into Level Eleven by deducing some Pillar-level Fusion Rule to Second Realm.

Instead, it was through the unprecedented accumulation of the Sixth Realm of space-time, as well as the many peak Sixth Realm Pillar-level Fusion Rules, that he forcefully ascended to Level Eleven.

Just by initially stepping into Level Eleven, Lin Yuan was above all others at Level Eleven; even those at the Perfect Level Eleven with the most powerful weapons could only hope to save their own lives in front of him.

“I even told the Galaxy Master to wait for me at Level Eleven?”

The Black Star Lord, seeing the discussion among the many Class A Tenth Rankers, recalled what he once said to the Galaxy Master, and suddenly felt a bit embarrassed.

The Black Star Lord could assure himself that he had said so from the bottom of his heart, without any intention to show off.

Who could have anticipated the Galaxy Master would cultivate so quickly?

The Black Star Lord’s original intention.

Was to wait for the Galaxy Master at Level Eleven.

But now.

It had turned into the Galaxy Master waiting for him at Level Eleven.

…

Central Star Field of Human Civilization.

A gigantic planet.

This planet belonged to the Xia Family, a vital stronghold of humanity’s Xia Family, where many important members of the Xia Family, as well as that Level Eleven elder of the Xia Family, resided.

Inside a certain manor.

Xia Keran was spending time with Lin Yi; after their marriage, they had moved to live on this planet, which was also a symbol of core clan member status within the Xia Family.

“The elder wants to see me?”

Xia Keran suddenly received the message and his heart tightened instantly.

The Level Eleven elder of the human Xia Family held a revered position, and direct descendants like Xia Keran, theoretically speaking, wouldn’t have the chance to see the elder from birth until death.

But because of his association with Lin Yi, Xia Keran had the fortune to be summoned by the elder twice on his own.

Once, when it was known that he was involved with the sister of the Galaxy Master, and a second time, on the eve of his marriage to Lin Yi.

These were the only two times Xia Keran had been summoned by the elder.

And now, this was the third time.

“What could the elder want to see me for?”

Xia Keran was quite nervous in his heart; being summoned by the elder did not necessarily mean good news.

It could be said that most of the Xia Family members summoned by the elder were for bad reasons, having to face the elder’s wrath and punishment.

“Don’t worry.”

“It shouldn’t be anything major.”

Lin Yi reassured from beside him.

“Let’s hope.”

Xia Keran’s expression was somber as he stood up and headed toward the palace where the elder was in seclusion.

Before long.

Xia Keran walked out from the palace, his face full of bewilderment.

This time the elder of the Xia Family had summoned him, it wasn’t for something bad.

Rather, it was a good thing, a great good thing.

Xia Keran had never seen, the lofty elder of the Xia Family, show such a cordial side to himself.

Before today, the elder’s two summonses to him had only slightly expressed his concern, as well as the importance placed on that Galaxy Master.

But just now.

Xia Keran faintly sensed that the elder of the Xia Family… was relieved?

And all of this was because—

“The Galaxy Master has stepped into Level Eleven?”

Xia Keran recalled the news he had received from the elder.

Although it was almost inevitable for the Galaxy Master to step into Level Eleven, the fact that he did so in less than three hundred years meant that the potential capability and talent of the Galaxy Master were even above everyone’s estimations.

And the Galaxy Master, having stepped into Level Eleven, has officially become part of the decision-making echelon just below the strongest of human civilization.

In terms of status, not in the least bit inferior to the Xia Family’s old ancestor, and even the future of the Galaxy Master is expected to be much more dazzling and bright than that of the Xia Family.

…

Inside the manor.

“My brother, he has become a Level Eleven?” Lin Yi received this news from Xia Keran’s mouth and was somewhat stunned.

For Lin Yi now, Lin Yuan has become a spiritual pillar, but stepping into Level Eleven? Wasn’t that too fast?

Before she was engaged to marry Xia Keran, Lin Yi might not have been so shocked. But the more she interacted with him, the more she realized what this meant.

“The old ancestor personally told me, it can’t be false.”

Xia Keran swallowed hard, and even at this moment, the shock in his heart had not yet subsided.

…

“My disciple, has stepped into Level Eleven?” The Chikun Star Lord was at the Chikun Main Star, casually guiding the various Peak Masters.

After stepping into the Ninth Realm, the Chikun Star Lord’s ability to teach disciples had improved a lot, and consequently, two Peak Masters stepped into the Seventh Realm.

But now, having received news of Lin Yuan stepping into Level Eleven, a look of emotion immediately surfaced on the Chikun Star Lord’s face.

All of them were his disciples, yet these Peak Masters were still racking their brains on how to break through to the Seventh Realm, and Lin Yuan, the youngest Thirteenth Peak Master, has already stepped into Level Eleven?

“What?”

“Little junior brother has stepped into Level Eleven?”

“Teacher, this is great news.”

“Level Eleven? How long has it been, our little junior brother’s talent is too freakish.”

One after another, the Peak Masters couldn’t help but cry out in astonishment. A Tenth Rank Evolver? That was an existence so powerful they couldn’t even look up to.

“A happy event.”

“Indeed, a joyous occasion.”

The Chikun Star Lord’s face revealed a smile, while his heart was delighted.

Thanks to the Galaxy Master, who was his disciple, the Chikun Star Lord had no idea how much face he had gained in front of his friends.

The Ninth and Tenth Rank Evolvers from every major Star Domain of human civilization were extremely envious and jealous of the Chikun Star Lord.

To this, the Chikun Star Lord’s explanation was: “I couldn’t help it, I just accepted the Galaxy Master, and when luck comes, you can’t even block it.”

When the Galaxy Master was at the Tenth Rank, he had already made many Ninth and Tenth Rank Evolvers go green with envy, and now that the Galaxy Master had stepped into Level Eleven, the Chikun Star Lord could already predict that he would be subjected to his ‘good friends’ rebukes.

…

Lin Yuan’s stepping into Level Eleven not only influenced the scope of human civilization.

The peak powers of each major peak group in the cosmic starry skies also received the news at the first moment.

In a desolate starry sky.

Several towering figures converged.

“The human civilization’s Galaxy Master has stepped into Level Eleven? How could this be such a coincidence? Just after that human evolver who failed in the ultimate challenge?”

All of these towering figures were from the Insect Race and the Tianyu Clan’s strongest members, who have gathered together at this moment, discussing this matter.

Too coincidental.

The timing of the Galaxy Master stepping into Level Eleven was too coincidental.

So coincidental that these strongest beings couldn’t help but speculate.

“Could it be that the Galaxy Master is that evolver who failed in the ultimate challenge?”

A few of the strongest exchanged glances, the unthinkable idea crossing their minds.

“Impossible.”

“The Galaxy Master has only just stepped into Level Eleven. How could that cause the level of Chaos Void Origin Infusion?”

Immediately, some of the strongest objected.

Although the timing was close, it was just that, close – and upon closer thought, they realized how outrageous it actually was.

The attempt to break into Level Eleven and the ultimate challenge were not the same thing.

“It’s true.”

“Maybe we are overthinking it.”

The rest of the strongest nodded slightly.

Their speculation had no concrete evidence and was only based on conjecture.

“However, even if the Galaxy Master is not related to that evolver who failed in the ultimate challenge, the Galaxy Master who has stepped into Level Eleven will probably become quite a problem.”

“The opening of an ultra-large-scale battlefield is imminent, and we must think of a way to deal with the Galaxy Master.”

These towering figures communicated with one another.

…

The Starry Sky Races, upon hearing the Galaxy Master’s advancement to Level Eleven, were all in shock and emotion.

The Level Eleven rank already stands at the pinnacle of the universe, just below the strongest beings.

The name of Lin Yuan also shook the starry heavens for the first time.
